cli.usage:
Usage: kx-frame-controller-manager <command>

Commands:
  run                    Run as a resident process (started by the systemd unit)
  status                 Show SteamVR and 27062 reachability, and the serial match for each hand
  list                   List the controllers reported by 27062
  disconnect <target>    Disconnect without a long press. Target is left, right, both, or a serial
  install                Write and enable the systemd user unit and the update timer
  uninstall              Stop and remove the systemd user unit
  update [--auto]        Replace the executable with a newer release, restart the unit, and roll back if it does not start. The update timer passes --auto
  version                Print the version
cli.disconnect_needs_target: Give disconnect one target: left, right, both, or a serial
cli.config_invalid: The configuration has errors. Running with the previous (or default) settings:
status.steamvr_unavailable: SteamVR: not connected (not running, or libopenvr_api.so was not found)
status.link_ng: 27062: not reachable. Check that SteamVR is running
status.match_ng: {hand}: the OpenVR and 27062 serials do not match. This hand will not be disconnected
status.power_save_pending: Settings changed by power saving were not restored yet. The resident process restores them when it next connects to SteamVR
disconnect.no_target: No connected controller matches {target}. Nothing was disconnected
disconnect.unconfirmed: {target}: sent the request, but could not confirm the disconnect ({serial})
install.done:
Wrote and started the unit: {path}
Executable: {executable}
install.failed: Failed to enable the unit. Check the systemctl output above
uninstall.failed: Failed to remove the unit. Check the systemctl output above
update.up_to_date: You are on the latest version ({version})
update.unreachable: Could not check for updates. Check the network
update.incomplete: Could not fetch the whole release list, so the latest version is unknown
update.unknown: This is a local build ({version}); updates are not checked
update.disabled: Automatic updates are turned off in the configuration
update.not_due: update.check_interval_h has not passed since the last check
update.rejected: {tag} failed to start after a previous update, so it is skipped. Run update by hand to install it anyway
update.applied: Replaced with {tag}. The unit is not running, so it was not restarted
update.restarted: Replaced with {tag}, restarted the unit, and confirmed it started
update.rolled_back: Replaced with {tag}, but it did not start, so rolled back to {version}
update.rollback_failed: {tag} did not start and rolling back failed. Reinstall {path}
update.failed: Failed to replace the executable. The current one is left as is
error.power_off: Failed to detect the long press
